lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Welcome to Echo Valley! Look at the mountains. Now listen. Hello! Hello... hello... hello! That's an echo. Today we compare two things. Echo Valley is bigger than the plains. Say it with me. Echo Valley is bigger than the plains. Great! Big, bigger. Tall, taller. When we compare two things, we add e, r and say than. 2つを くらべる ときは ～er than だよ。 The mountains are taller than the trees. The river is longer than the road. Let's practice. An elephant is bigger than a dog. A giraffe is taller than a horse. Now you. Look at your pencil and your eraser. My pencil is longer than my eraser. Wonderful! Now, phonics. Taller. Tallest. Longer. Longest. Just add e, r or e, s, t. Tallest means number one. Okay, let's shout together. Hello, Echo Valley!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! We're in the forest of Echo Valley. Look at these trees. This tree is very tall. That tree is not so tall. So, this tree is taller than that tree. Say it with me. This tree is taller than that tree. Good! And that tree is shorter than this tree. Tall, taller. Short, shorter. たかいは taller、ひくいは shorter だよ。 Let's practice. Stand up, please. Stand on your toes. You are taller now! Crouch down. Now you are shorter. Which tree is taller? This one is. Which tree is shorter? That one is. Now, phonics. Larger. Nicest. Wider. Safest. This is the longest river in the valley. Great! Long, longer, longest. For number one, we say the and add e, s, t. いちばんは the ～est だよ。 Look at this rock. It's the biggest rock in the river. And here, the water is very deep. It's the deepest part. Be careful! Let's practice. Who is the tallest in your family? My dad is the tallest in my family. What is the biggest animal? lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today we're making the Valley Record Book. It has amazing animal records. Here is the first card. The cheetah is the fastest land animal. Say it with me. Cutest. Hotter. Earliest. Old, just add e, r. Cute, just add s, t. Hot, double the t. Early, change y to i. Now it's your turn. Choose an animal and make a record card. Read it to your friends!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Wow, look at this flower field! There are so many flowers. This flower is pretty. And this flower is very, very pretty. This flower is more beautiful. Say it with me. This flower is more beautiful. Lovely! Beautiful is a long word. We don't say beautifuler. We say more beautiful. ながい ことばは more を つけるよ。 More beautiful. More exciting. More interesting. Let's practice. Which is more exciting, a game or a book? For me, a game is more exciting. Which is more interesting, a movie or a comic? A comic is more interesting!
